# Palladium: EOS reconstruction reports

<!-- Generated by scripts.generate_reconstruction_reports; edit EOSMAT instead. -->

[All reconstruction reports](index.md) · [Material and EOS parameters](../material-summaries/palladium.md) · [EOSMAT record file](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/materials/palladium.eosmat) · [Audit sidecar](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/audits/palladium.audit.json)

Each section opens with the record's reproduction headline and any usage
warning ([label definitions](../eos-labels.md)), then the scope and basis of
the stored check. Only recorded content is shown: missing selections, weights,
errors or conventions are unknown, not zero, and are not inferred. Generating
this page fits nothing and changes no classification or source coefficient.
Every record is also listed by identifier in the
[numerical ledger](../primary-eos-refits.md#records), its
[machine-readable form](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/docs/data/primary-eos-refits.json) and the
[source-audit reports](../source-audits.md).

**Curves and residuals** replay the full stored source and reconstructed
coefficients on the same recorded audit inputs. Residual = model − input in
the fitted quantity's native units; for pressure, P(model) − P(input) at each
input volume and temperature (isothermal records use their reference
temperature). RMS is an unweighted descriptive error, not a parameter
uncertainty or the weighted fitting objective. With more than five
temperatures, the minimum, middle and maximum isotherms are drawn; residuals
include every selected row. Error bars appear only where all widths are
recoverable and keep the source meaning, including digitization widths.
No uncertainty band is inferred.

**Coefficient graphs** show stored central values and recorded error widths
in the audit's units; each panel includes zero. They are not observation or
residual plots. Fixed/adopted values are constraints, not recovered values.
Tables round an error to two significant digits when its leading digit is 1
or 2, otherwise one, and the value to the error's decimal place; values
without a positive error show at most six significant digits. Full precision
stays in EOSMAT and the ledger.

The exact author constraints and EoSFit7-GUI workflow are not recovered. V0 fixed at 58.868 A^3 is a diagnostic constraint, not a documented author choice. Using Table 2's isolated 58.863 A^3 does not resolve the misfit. The published fixed-Kprime=4 curve shows systematic poor agreement with Table 1 despite numerical coefficient parity; corrected diagnostic reduced chi-square is about 25 under the documented independent absolute-error assumptions.

The correctly weighted diagnostic refit remains poor (reduced chi-square about 25 under independent absolute-error assumptions). Published coefficients are preserved; agreement of K0 does not validate the curve.

## Frost et al. (2023), Vinet

**close** · `palladium_frost_2023_vinet_1` · `Vinet` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/palladium.md#record-palladium_frost_2023_vinet_1)

**Warning:** Not recommended for quantitative use. Default selection on hold pending review. Never chosen automatically; select it explicitly. The authors' fitting objective and covariance convention are unstated, so the published fit is not fully reproduced.

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** Every compared free coefficient meets either the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison or parameter-specific numerical similarity screen; the audit does not classify the complete comparison as parity.

**Source review:** `not_reproduced`.

- All 93 verified source rows are independently fitted using sigma(P)=0.1 GPa and sigma(V)=3a^2 sigma(a). The final paper specifies uncertainty-aware Marquardt-Levenberg but not its exact objective, ambient-point inclusion, constraints or covariance convention. Numerical classification remains similar: the combined-two-width coefficient test fails with absolute-error covariance but passes with residual-scaled covariance. Original author-fit reproduction is unresolved; scientific status not\_reproduced and recommendation/default hold pending protocol clarification. This does not establish a failed replay of the authors' protocol. Measured-volume pressure RMS is 0.771992 GPa published and 0.825323 GPa refitted; the earlier 0.276359 GPa used adjusted volumes. See the \[Frost audit\](literature-reproductions/palladium-frost-2023-audit.md). The original author regression remains unrecovered. The final paper specifies uncertainty-aware Marquardt-Levenberg fitting but not the exact objective, ambient-point inclusion, constraints or covariance convention. Independent refits have similar central coefficients; the combined-two-width comparison fails with absolute-error covariance and passes with residual-scaled covariance. This is not a demonstrated failed replay of the author protocol. Quantitative recommendation and the default remain on hold pending clarification.
- The original author regression remains unrecovered. The final paper specifies uncertainty-aware Marquardt-Levenberg fitting but not the exact objective, ambient-point inclusion, constraints or covariance convention. Independent refits have similar central coefficients; the combined-two-width comparison fails with absolute-error covariance and passes with residual-scaled covariance. This is not a demonstrated failed replay of the author protocol. Quantitative recommendation and the default remain on hold pending clarification.
- Usage recommendation: not\_recommended\_for\_quantitative\_use
